subject.title: fix(whatsapp): normalize hosted JIDs consistently with Baileys

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this fail-closed migration policy for shipped WhatsApp LID-form allowlists: automatically convert only verified mappings and leave every unresolved or conflicting entry unauthorized with a doctor warning?
rationale: This is a deliberate authorization and upgrade-policy choice, not a mechanical correctness gap: retaining the old behavior risks same-digit PN/LID authorization, while fail-closing can stop a previously configured operator until manual repair.

options.title: Approve guarded fail-closed migration
options.body: Keep the proposed verified-mapping-only conversion and warning path, with the explicit understanding that unresolved legacy LID entries require operator repair.

options.title: Preserve legacy authorization temporarily
options.body: Define and document a bounded compatibility strategy before merge if maintainers judge upgrade disruption worse than the ambiguity of legacy LID entries.

options.title: Pause pending policy clarification
options.body: Hold the PR until WhatsApp owners specify the durable allowlist identity contract and expected operator recovery experience.

recommendation.title: Approve guarded fail-closed migration
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed verified-mapping-only conversion and warning path, with the explicit understanding that unresolved legacy LID entries require operator repair.

likelyOwner.reason: The current implementation author is best positioned to explain the proposed mapping and recovery semantics to the approving owner.
